items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 and all volumes (18, 1, 10 uL mix) use the p20; labware loaded with the required labels, and the simulator and end-state checks pass.

One tip is reused for master mix into empty wells; a fresh tip is used per colony and per primer, all tips are dropped, and tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination all pass.
Steps 1–4 run in the specified order with the given volumes, the 3x mix follows the template dispense, and the seal/thermocycle comment is recorded; the added blow_outs don't change the outcome.
Loop aspirates and dispenses 18 uL from reservoir A1 into all 96 pcr_plate wells; end_state:pcr_plate passes.
The zip loops transfer 1 uL colony and 1 uL primer from matching wells to matching PCR wells with p20, and end_state checks pass.
The final protocol.comment records sealing and the full program: 98C 30 s; 30x [98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; 4C hold.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and passes all measured checks. Volumes, pipette choice, tip handling and the thermocycling comment all match the task.
